description: A second work apron, folded and kept for hands that have not come. It is made of heavy, unbleached linen and bears no stains from use, unlike the one I wear. It stays tucked in the bottom of my pack, pressed flat against the spare clothes to keep the creases sharp. The fabric is coarse and smells faintly of dust and sun, a small weight that pulls at my shoulder whenever I turn to see if anyone is following.
soul_link_note: The place Ilsa keeps at the empty end of her bench has one portable heart: the spare apron she lays out and works around. The laid-out second place is carded as travelling with the soul, and an apron fits any work, so it goes wherever the reshuffle seats her.
